name: Huntress
summary: Kenton's boat, docked at Island Dreams, used to sail out to the shipwreck dive sites.
body: Push Square says the player can sail to the Underwater Discoveries in Kenton's Huntress, docked at Island Dreams, or in the Rugger Fortune after the mission Maritime Disputes.
GTA BOOM says the boat from the Island Dreams mission is back at the dock afterwards with scuba tanks at the stern; it does not name the boat.

facts.availability: Docked at Island Dreams Boat Charters, Key Lento

name: Imponte Soaring Phoenix
summary: A Phoenix variant The Big Lead found parked in a Watson Bay garage.
body: The Big Lead mentions an Imponte Soaring Phoenix parked in a garage just over the river south of a Los Santos Pounders card location in Watson Bay.

name: Invetero Spiderweb Coquette
summary: A unique Coquette in a party house garage in south-east Key Lento, opened with keypad code 092319.
body: The Big Lead says a unique Invetero Spiderweb Coquette sits in the garage of the party house in the south-east corner of Key Lento, and gives 092319 as the garage keypad code.

facts.availability: Party house garage, south-east Key Lento
